'''Alys''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who worked as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republics]]' [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the conflict, she worked on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] with her partner [[Kesler]].<ref name="TORATS" />
